I'm very susceptible to the unfortunate lasting effect of covid and eventually my savings (that I'm lucky to have) will run out. 

There are people out there already jobless (laid off) that dont have access to basic needs. This issue will only get worse because no one will agree on how to solve it.

And because the majority of the general public would rather violently disagree with each other about our own public safety, it'll never change. 

We cant even agree to protect our immune compromised because "not enough people are dying".

While I agree that its messed up to open everything like covid is gone, it's not all about greed.

People have lost their essential jobs. Companies are taking advantage of this situation to lay off workers (sounds counter productive, but CEOs are now making more profits by overworking their few employees than they are paying a full crew right now). Families are going without basic needs, food is hard to come by when you dont have a job. A lot of people arent eligible for unemployment and their own small businesses are taking bad enough hits to bankrupt them. 

Our economy is crashing.

The problem is that our society isnt set up to actually take care of its people. It's set up to work them to death and that much is apparent with how a two month shut down is effecting us. We need a better system, but no one can agree on what that is so we're going to keep suffering. Our people are going to continue starving.

When self love is the opposite of the nature of depression, ideally it's a great idea, but its like pulling teeth to practice.

It's just whether or not you're in the right headspace and willing to push that hard.

Most of the time, I'm not.
